source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Use these to complete the bridge defect check lists for each maintenance area and to create a maintenance job sheet.
3. Follow the rules outlined on the bridge defect check list and in the 'notes' sections of the map pdfs.
4. Mark up the maintenance areas on a map where the defects have been found (in red) (Use Word or Powerpoint to mark up the PDF - see example map).
5. Use these maps and the defect check lists to compile the report.
6. File the completed report.
7. Use the 'Next steps' section to plan the actions needed for full maintenance/construction of the bridge or structural section.

## Maintenance record sheet
